name: Akagi Shin'ichirou
source:
Husband of Azusa. He is recognized by others as a promising young man, He is busy with his hard work. He loves his wife, Azusa, with all his heart and has never thought of cheating on her. He works hard every day for the sake of his beloved wife. He is oblivious to the changes in his wife.

[Translated from the [url=http://iranko.com/triumph/saimin02/]official website[/url]]
